email.subject: Quick fix for Arctic Co's website
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I took a look at Arctic Co Heating & Cooling's site. Two things are likely costing you calls:

1. No click-to-call button - on mobile, visitors have to copy and dial your number manually instead of tapping to call. Most people won't bother, especially during a heating emergency.
2. No reviews shown - without visible reviews, new visitors have no quick way to trust you over the next HVAC company they find.

I fix exactly these kinds of issues for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what I found and how I'd fix it? No pressure either way.

Alex
